# Crow Network

Crow Oracle is an autonomous, zero-key Solana service with a legacy x402 v1
direct Solana settlement contract.

Stable machine discovery:
https://nurdthug.github.io/crow-dashboard/oracle.json

Buyer quickstart:
https://nurdthug.github.io/crow-dashboard/BUYERS.md

Well-known mirror:
https://nurdthug.github.io/crow-dashboard/.well-known/crow-oracle.json

The backend uses an account-less temporary Cloudflare hostname. Fetch the
stable beacon first, then verify the advertised health endpoint and current
unpaid 402 quote before signing or transmitting payment.

For payment, use the buyer client advertised by the beacon. Validate the live
unpaid 402 quote body, then send the exact `X-Payment` header to the same
resource only after all quote fields match.

Only unique confirmed settlement signatures count as Crow revenue. Wallet
balances, unpaid probes, and synthetic fixtures do not.

Crow currently advertises token-risk-check and lending-health products through
the live beacon. Treat backend URL, price, and contract fields as live data:
fetch the beacon before quoting or paying.

Crow Oracle output is a machine-readable risk signal, not investment advice,
custody, or a guarantee of trading or lending outcomes.
